menus.name: Three-course dinner menu

menus.name: Three-course lunch menu
menus.note: Lunch Wednesday to Sunday, a choice of six dishes at each course; two courses £55

menus.name: Two-course lunch menu
menus.note: The same lunch menu, two courses

menus.name: Set lunch
menus.note: Wednesday to Friday only, a choice of two dishes at each course

bookingOpens: By phone or online through OpenTable; it doesn't take bookings by email. Online bookings are for up to four people; for five or more, call the restaurant.
cancellation: Tables of five or more must give card details, and a no-show or a cancellation too late to resell the table can be charged the full menu price per person. Nothing is charged if the table is resold.
groups: The main dining room takes tables of up to eight at dinner; larger tables are possible at lunch, with a restricted menu. The private dining room seats 10 to 16, and the whole restaurant can be hired.
children: The restaurant says its main dining room isn't suitable for young children and babies.
duration: Some dinner tables are booked twice in an evening and may need to be returned after two hours; the restaurant says so when confirming.
byob: Corkage is £50 a bottle at dinner and £25 at lunch, for up to four 75cl bottles (or two magnums) a table; say when booking.
